items.example_en: Our flat is on the third floor.
items.note: на plus prepositional for floors: на этаже.

items.example_en: We always eat in the kitchen.
items.note: The kitchen takes на, not в. A Russian oddity worth memorising.

items.example_en: The bedroom looks onto the courtyard.
items.note: From спать, to sleep.

items.example_en: The bathroom is at the end of the corridor.
items.note: An adjective used as a noun. The toilet is separate: туалет.

items.example_en: We're watching a film in the living room.
items.note: From гость, guest: the room for receiving guests.

items.example: На выходные мы едем на дачу.
items.example_en: We're going to the dacha for the weekend.
items.note: A cultural institution, not simply a second home.

items.example_en: The keys are on the table.
items.note: на plus prepositional: на столе. Stress shifts to the ending.

items.example_en: The cat sleeps under the bed.
items.note: Feminine despite ending in a consonant, because of the soft sign.

items.example_en: Hang the coat in the wardrobe.
items.note: Motion into takes the accusative: в шкаф. Position inside takes в шкафу.

items.example_en: The lamp is next to the sofa.
items.note: с plus instrumental: с диваном.

items.example_en: The bakery is opposite my building.
items.note: Takes the genitive: напротив дома.

items.example_en: We're moving at the end of the month.
items.note: A prefixed verb of motion: пере- means across or over.

items.example_en: I wake up at seven.
items.note: Imperfective for the habit; проснуться (perfective) for one occasion.

items.example_en: She gets up early on Saturdays.
items.note: Perfective встать. по plus dative means on recurring days.

items.example_en: I take a shower before leaving.
Get dressed, we're leaving in five minutes.
items.note: Reflexive: the -ся ending means dressing oneself.

items.example: Я езжу на работу на велосипеде.
items.example_en: I cycle to work.
items.note: идти is on foot, ехать is by vehicle. Work takes на, not в.

items.example_en: I go to bed around midnight.
items.note: Perfective лечь: я лягу спать.

items.example_en: We clean on Saturday mornings.
items.note: Also убирать квартиру, without the reflexive.

items.example_en: You cook, I'll wash the dishes.
items.note: посуда is a collective singular: crockery.

items.example_en: I do laundry on Sundays.
items.note: Washing clothes is стирать; washing dishes or yourself is мыть.

items.example_en: Don't forget to take out the rubbish.
I usually have lunch at one.
items.note: Sits naturally at the start of the sentence.

items.example: Время от времени я занимаюсь спортом.
items.example_en: From time to time I do some sport.
items.note: время is a neuter noun with an irregular declension.

items.example_en: I'm looking for a warm coat.
items.note: искать has an irregular stem: ищу, ищешь.

items.example: Мне нравится этот свитер, можно померить?
items.example_en: I like this jumper, can I try it on?
items.note: можно plus infinitive is the everyday may I.

items.example_en: Do you have a bigger size?
items.note: по- on a comparative softens it: a bit bigger.

items.example_en: The fitting rooms are at the end of the hall.
items.note: Another adjective used as a noun.

items.example_en: I think this colour suits me.
items.note: Literally it goes to me: dative plus идти.

items.example_en: Great, I'll take it.
items.note: Present tense of брать, used for the decision.

items.example_en: Forty euros, that's too expensive.
items.note: Opposite: дёшево.

items.example: На всю коллекцию скидка тридцать процентов.
items.example_en: There's thirty percent off the whole collection.
items.note: распродажа is a sale event.

items.example_en: Can I pay by card?
items.note: The means takes the instrumental: картой, наличными.

items.example_en: Do you need the receipt?
items.note: Also a bank cheque, but the receipt sense is far more common.

items.example_en: Keep the change.
items.note: The genitive сдачи after не надо: negation pulls the genitive.

items.example_en: We're saving money for a trip.
items.note: деньги is plural only. на plus accusative for the purpose.
